## Static finding in shipped code and current main

Published `pm-linear@2026.10.3` (npm gitHead `cb914b21798d7b5e1dc5830af09737469d2448d8`) and main `55ed55fcd6086865aa39e4da03a9899b2f03de21` both use this [local reader](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-linear/blob/55ed55fcd6086865aa39e4da03a9899b2f03de21/index.ts#L1124):

```ts
["--path", pmRoot, "--json", "list", "--full", "--include-body", "--limit", "10000"]
// after a zero exit:
const parsed = JSON.parse(result.stdout);
const items = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : parsed.items ?? parsed.results ?? [];
return items as PmItem[];
```

The 16 MiB buffer only bounds transport. The reader does not request all statuses or strict/unbounded output and never validates pagination, source completeness, field omissions, or universal output-budget receipts.

## Failure mechanism and impact

The exact decoder accepts
`{items:[{id:"fixture-1"}], count:1, total:10001, truncated:true, has_more:true, next_cursor:"more"}`
as a whole corpus. A missing `items` field becomes an empty success.

The existing Linear-provenance index then misses local matches, risking duplicate creation on sync; export can silently omit tasks. This differs from remote GraphQL pagination: even a fully fetched remote result is reconciled against an uncertified local subset.

This is **source/artifact evidence**, not a live Linear reproduction. The review environment denied child-process fixtures with `spawnSync … EPERM`; those tests were stopped. No Linear API request, paid call, or private transmission was performed.

## Acceptance

Use public SDK `listAllComplete`, or certify canonical strict/all-status/full/unbounded responses. Refuse partial/malformed/missing/compacted/omitted answers before mutations. Cover >10,000 local items, matching closed/canceled work, degraded output receipts and re-import idempotency. An in-process public SDK reader also removes the extra CLI launch and full JSON serialization overhead; retain correct complete selection when introducing projections or streaming.

Duplicate check: all-status GitHub issue/PR pages and main PM tracker checked October 5; no corresponding open fix. [pm-linear-92kd](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-linear/blob/55ed55fcd6086865aa39e4da03a9899b2f03de21/.agents/pm/issues/pm-linear-92kd.toon) fixed remote GraphQL pagination; [pm-linear-4so4](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-linear/blob/55ed55fcd6086865aa39e4da03a9899b2f03de21/.agents/pm/issues/pm-linear-4so4.toon) fixed changelog reads. Neither certifies this local integration reader.
